title: Sales call: quote for a delivery company

lines.text: Thanks for making time today. We run about three thousand five hundred parcels a month across two depots.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: Our monthly volume is 3500 parcels, and it grows every quarter.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: That fits our standard plan well. Let me walk you through how the routing module works.
Does the setup fee include training for the depot staff?
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: Good question, I need to check that with our onboarding team before I promise anything.
The one time setup fee is 1200 dollars, and the monthly price depends on volume.
That is a bit higher than the other offer we saw, but the routing looks better.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: I will send you a revised quote by Friday with the volume discount included.
Great. I will share our depot shipping volumes by Wednesday so you can size it properly.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: Perfect, that helps a lot. Anything about the integration with your warehouse system?
It is an old system, we will need an export file once a day.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: Let us start with a pilot in March at the north depot only, and decide on the second depot after that.
lines.name: Dana

lines.text: Agreed, a pilot at the north depot in March.
